zh: 用前缀和表示内部总和：子段 [l,r] 稳定，当且仅当 a[l]=a[r] 且 P[r]−P[l+1]=a[l]，其中 P[i] 是前 i 项之和。
把条件移项成“相同的二元组”：左端 l 对应键 (a[l], P[l+1]+a[l])，右端 r 对应键 (a[r], P[r])；扫描右端时，用哈希表统计之前每个左端键出现的次数。
先算前缀和（用 64 位）；r 从 0 扫到 n−1，每步先把 l=r−2（若 ≥0）的键加入计数，保证子段长度至少为 3；再把计数表中键 (a[r], P[r]) 的次数加到答案上；最后输出答案。
en: Write the inner sum with prefix sums: segment [l, r] is stable exactly when a[l] = a[r] and P[r] - P[l + 1] = a[l], where P[i] is the sum of the first i values.
Rearrange the condition into equal pairs: left end l has key (a[l], P[l + 1] + a[l]) and right end r has key (a[r], P[r]); while scanning right ends, count earlier left-end keys in a hash map.

Compute prefix sums in 64 bits; scan r from 0 to n - 1, first adding the key of l = r - 2 (when l >= 0) so every segment has length at least 3, then adding the count stored for (a[r], P[r]) to the answer; print the answer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Let the prefix P[i] be the sum of the first i elements. Scan the right end r, counting each l<=r-2 under the key (a[l],P[l+1]+a[l]), and query the key (a[r],P[r]).

## Proof of correctness

The stability condition is equivalent to a[l]=a[r] and P[r]-P[l+1]=a[l], and rearranging gives exactly equal key pairs. Inserting only l<=r-2 guarantees a length of at least 3, the hash counts keep every distinct left end, and each segment is counted exactly once at its own right end.

## Complexity

O(n) time, O(n) space; prefix sums use 64-bit integers.
